title: Hosting a website on an 8-bit microcontroller
summary: An experimental project that demonstrates running a complete web server and hosting a website on an 8-bit microcontroller, pushing the limits of embedded systems capabilities. The project showcases how web technology can be implemented in extremely resource-constrained environments.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the feasibility of running web services on extremely limited hardware platforms typically not considered capable of such tasks.
why_valuable: Serves as both an educational resource for understanding low-level networking and a proof-of-concept that expands the boundaries of what's possible with minimal hardware resources.
